# AgentMate — AI-native Backend as Toolset

AgentMate exposes personal productivity tools (Todos, Notes, Reports) as structured APIs
for any AI Agent to consume via REST or MCP. No UI — pure API product.

## Base URL

```
http://localhost:26001
```

## Authentication

Two methods, both resolve to a `user_id`:

1. **JWT** (interactive users):
   - `POST /auth/login` → returns `{"token": "<jwt>"}`
   - Header: `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`

2. **API Key** (agents):
   - Header: `X-Api-Key: ak_<key>` OR `Authorization: Bearer ak_<key>`
   - Create keys at `POST /auth/apikeys` (requires JWT)

## Scopes

API Keys support optional scopes: `todos:r`, `todos:rw`, `notes:r`, `notes:rw`,
`reports:r`, `reports:rw`, `bookmarks:r`, `bookmarks:rw`, `expenses:r`,
`expenses:rw`, `skills:r`, `skills:rw`, `manage_keys`. Empty scopes = full access.

## Response Format

All endpoints return:
```json
{"code": 0, "data": <payload>, "message": "ok"}
{"code": 40001, "data": null, "message": "unauthorized"}
{"code": 40400, "data": null, "message": "not found"}
```

Note: Some list endpoints return bare arrays directly (not wrapped).

---

## Auth Endpoints

```
POST /auth/register        body: {email, password}
POST /auth/login           body: {email, password} → {token}
GET  /auth/me              → {id, email, role}
POST /auth/apikeys         body: {name, scopes?, expires_at?} → {id, key, name}
GET  /auth/apikeys         → [{id, name, key_prefix, created_at, scopes}]
DELETE /auth/apikeys/:id
```

---

## Todos

```
POST   /todos              body: {title*, description, priority(low/medium/high), due_date, tags[]}
GET    /todos              ?status=pending|in_progress|done &priority=low|medium|high &tag=xxx &limit=20 &offset=0
GET    /todos/search       ?q=<text>
GET    /todos/:id
PATCH  /todos/:id          body: {title, description, status, priority, due_date, tags}
DELETE /todos/:id
```

Todo status values: `pending` | `in_progress` | `done`

---

## Notes

```
POST   /notes              body: {title*, content, tags[]}
GET    /notes              ?tag=xxx &limit=20 &offset=0
GET    /notes/search       ?q=<text>
GET    /notes/:id
PATCH  /notes/:id          body: {title, content, tags}
DELETE /notes/:id
```

---

## Reports

Reports store Agent-generated content (Markdown or HTML).

```
POST   /reports            body: {title*, content, format(md/html), tags[], source, source_key_id auto-injected}
GET    /reports            ?source=xxx &tag=xxx &limit=20 &offset=0
GET    /reports/sources    → [{source, count}]   ← for sidebar filtering
GET    /reports/search     ?q=<text>              ← full-text search (title+content)
GET    /reports/:id        ← includes full content field
PATCH  /reports/:id        body: {title, tags, source}  ← content immutable
DELETE /reports/:id
```

**source naming convention**:
- Recurring tasks: descriptive name e.g. `github-trending-daily`, `heguan-weekly`
- One-off reports: `adhoc`

`source_key_id` is auto-injected from the calling API Key — no need to pass it.
List responses omit `content` for performance; use GET /:id for full content.

---

## Tags

```
GET /tags                  ?module=todos|notes|reports|all (default: all)
```

Returns aggregated tag counts per module:
```json
{
  "todos": [{"tag": "dev", "count": 3}, ...],
  "notes": [...],
  "reports": [...]
}
```

All tags are stored lowercase. Pass tags as lowercase strings when creating/updating.

---

## Skills

```
POST /skills/index         body: {skill_name?}      # index active skills into retrieval
POST /skills/search        body: {query*, top_k?, include_content?}
GET  /skills/versions/active ?skill_name=<name>
POST /skills/versions/:id/activate
```

`/skills/search` returns ranked active skill cards from the vector retrieval store.
Run `/skills/index` after publishing or activating skills until background indexing is added.

---

## Typical Agent Workflow

### 1. Authenticate
```bash
# Using API Key (recommended for agents)
curl http://localhost:26001/todos \
  -H "X-Api-Key: ak_your_key"
```

### 2. Create a Todo
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:26001/todos \
  -H "X-Api-Key: ak_your_key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"title":"Task title","priority":"medium","tags":["work"]}'
```

### 3. Save a Report
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:26001/reports \
  -H "X-Api-Key: ak_your_key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"title":"GitHub Trending 2026-05-20","content":"# Trending\n...","format":"md","source":"github-trending-daily","tags":["github","daily"]}'
```

### 4. Filter by Source
```bash
curl "http://localhost:26001/reports?source=github-trending-daily" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: ak_your_key"
```

### 5. Search Across Content
```bash
curl "http://localhost:26001/reports/search?q=kubernetes" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: ak_your_key"
```

---

## MCP Server

AgentMate also exposes Streamable HTTP MCP servers on the main API port:

```
POST /mcp          # todos, notes, reports, bookmarks, expenses
POST /mcp/skills   # skill logs, versions, search, and indexing
```

Authenticate with `X-Api-Key: ak_your_key`, `Authorization: Bearer ak_your_key`,
or `?api_key=ak_your_key`. MCP tool calls enforce the same API key scopes as REST.

Available MCP tools:
- `todo_create`, `todo_list`, `todo_get`, `todo_update`, `todo_delete`, `todo_search`
- `note_create`, `note_list`, `note_get`, `note_update`, `note_delete`, `note_search`, `note_append`
- `report_create`, `report_list`, `report_get`, `report_update`, `report_delete`, `report_search`
- `bookmark_save`, `bookmark_list`, `bookmark_get`, `bookmark_update`, `bookmark_mark_read`, `bookmark_delete`, `bookmark_search`
- `expense_add`, `expense_list`, `expense_summary`, `expense_search`, `expense_update`, `expense_delete`
- `skill_log_add`, `skill_logs_list`, `skill_version_publish`, `skill_version_get_active`, `skill_stats`, `skill_signals`, `skill_search`, `skill_index_active`

---

## Error Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 0 | Success |
| 40001 | Unauthorized (missing or invalid credentials) |
| 40301 | Forbidden (insufficient scope) |
| 40400 | Not found |
| 40000 | Bad request |
| 50000 | Internal server error |
